feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 October 2026 7:55am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 10 October 2026 at 7:55am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north of the British Isles, with a ridge of high pressure extending from the Azores towards Greenland, tracking eastwards and declining.


##Wind##

West to Northwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7, decreasing 4 or 5 later this evening, then 2 to 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the east of the area this morning, becoming slight or moderate this evening, then slight overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West to Northwest 2 to 4, backing South tomorrow morning, then increasing Southeast 4 or 5 in the afternoon. Increasing 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the evening, then veering Southerly 4 to 6 overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreads from the west tomorrow evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.
